content.comment_body: Hello, I'm interested in the maximum number of APIs that can be configured in the [product_name]. In my current setup, I have 120 weekly timers and want to send an HTTP notification each time a timer activates. Since each timer starts at a different time, I require 120 separate notifications. Is this achievable with this product? Thank you

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking about the API configuration limits of the [product_name], particularly about managing HTTP notifications for a large set of individually scheduled timers. The user highlights a need for scalability and personalized event processing via the product’s API functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to facilitate configuring a substantial number of APIs or sending individual HTTP notifications, seeking support for up to at least 120 unique events.
